name: Test1
title: Test 1
description: A conversation between Sophia and Ethan about visiting a local art exhibition
instructions: You will hear three conversations with following context.
Passage1 Context: Two friends are deciding how to celebrate a birthday on a limited budget
Passage2 Context: Two college students are selecting a volunteer activity for their community service hours.
Passage3 Context: Two coworkers are discussing what to do about a broken work laptop
Each conversation is followed by a set of multiple-choice questions.
Choose the best answer for each question.

passages.title: Planning a Small Birthday Celebration
passages.setting: Two friends are deciding how to celebrate a birthday on a limited budget

conversation.name: Person1
conversation.text: Hey, the birthday’s next week. Any plans for what we should do?

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: I thought of booking that rooftop lounge, but it’s over $300 for the evening.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: That’s too steep. How about something more casual, like a picnic at the lakeside

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: I like the sound of that. We could bring snacks, a cake, and maybe a speaker for music.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Exactly! Plus, the weather’s been great lately.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Any concerns about permits?

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Nah, it’s public space. As long as we don’t put up tents or use grills, we’re fine.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Sounds perfect. Let’s do it.

questions.question: Why is the rooftop lounge not selected?

choices.text: It’s too expensive for their budget

questions.question: What makes the park a suitable alternative?

choices.text: It has free Wi-Fi and restrooms
It’s a casual, outdoor space with no cost

questions.question: What will they likely bring to the celebration?

passages.title: Choosing a Volunteer Activity
passages.setting: Two college students are selecting a volunteer activity for their community service hours.

conversation.name: Person1
conversation.text: We still need 8 hours of community service before the semester ends.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Yeah, I was thinking of helping at the animal shelter.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: That’s nice, but I have allergies around cats and dogs.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Right. What about tutoring elementary kids in reading?

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: That’s more my speed. Plus, we can do it on campus

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: There’s also a park cleanup this Saturday, but it’s early—7 a.m.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: No thanks. I’m not a morning person. Let’s stick with tutoring.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Agreed. I’ll sign us up.

questions.question: Why is volunteering at the animal shelter rejected?
What do they finally decide to do for volunteering?

passages.title: Fixing a Broken Laptop
passages.setting: Two coworkers are discussing what to do about a broken work laptop

conversation.name: Person1
conversation.text: My laptop froze again this morning. It’s been acting up all week.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Did you try updating the software or restarting in safe mode?

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Yep. Still super slow and glitchy

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Then maybe take it to TechCare. They fix office machines fast.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Isn’t that place kind of expensive?

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: A bit, but they offer diagnostics for free, and you don’t pay unless they fix it.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Hmm, that’s fair. I also thought of just buying a new one.

conversation.name: Person 2
conversation.text: Might be overkill if this one is fixable. Try TechCare first.

conversation.name: Person 1
conversation.text: Good point. I’ll drop it off after lunch.

questions.question: What problem is the speaker experiencing?

choices.text: The device is running slowly and freezing

questions.question: What is one concern about using TechCare?
What do they decide to do in the end?

choices.text: Wait and see if the problem resolves
Take the laptop to a repair shop
